topic: Your brain: 2% of your weight, 20% of your energy

sources.title: Why Does the Brain Need So Much Power?
How much energy does your brain require?
Do People Only Use 10 Percent of Their Brains?

claims.text: The brain is about 2% of body weight.
claims.quote: which is about 2% of the total body weight; Your brain accounts for roughly two percent of your body weight

claims.text: The brain uses up to about 20% of the body's energy (at rest).
claims.quote: The brain consumes up to 20% of the energy used by the human body, more than any other organ; accounting for up to 20 percent of the body's total haul; it consumes about 20% of the total energy in the body at rest

claims.text: It accounts for about 20% of total body oxygen consumption.
claims.quote: 20% of total body oxygen consumption; the human brain accounts for about 20% of the total oxygen consumption when a person is at rest

claims.text: It uses about 25% of total body glucose.
It receives about 15% of cardiac output.
claims.quote: it receives 15% of the cardiac output

claims.text: The idea that people use only 10% of their brain is a myth.
claims.quote: nor that normal humans use only ten per cent of the brain; the "10 percent myth" is so wrong it is almost laughable

myths.myth: You only use 10% of your brain.
myths.truth: A myth; the video says so.
